items.title: PostgreSQL 19 Beta 3.
Several correctness fixes rode in with the security release.
WAL-replay self-deadlock fixed (PG 14/15/16).
Neon: Electric (sync engine) joins Neon
Supabase: extension version pinning deprecated
Aug 11 batch: 8.3.8 / 8.0.29 / 7.0.40 — ~23 CVEs, worst is CVE-2026-18691 (CVSS 9.0), improper authentication in intra-cluster connections allowing credential exposure.
Same batch: memory-safety bugs with RCE potential in time-series and `$graphLookup`.
Authorization bypasses worth reading if you rely on RBAC as a boundary.
Jul 22 batch: 8.3.7 / 8.2.12 / 8.0.28 / 7.0.39 — ~24 CVEs, worst is CVE-2026-13072 (CVSS 9.2), memory corruption via improper input validation in Compute Mode external data processing.
CVE-2026-14881 (CVSS 8.4): Compass connection import overrides the OIDC browser-open command → arbitrary shell execution.
BI Connector ODBC driver: five CVEs, one at CVSS 9.5.
CVE-2026-18710 (CVSS 8.2): cleartext storage of credentials in driver logging during client initialization.
MongoDB 8.2 reached end of life July 31, 2026
8.3.7 (Jul 22) imposes a cap on active multi-document transactions (SERVER-108215).
MongoDB 9.0 is visibly in flight.
Percona Server for MongoDB 8.0.28-12 shipped Aug 10
SERVER-83322 (8.3.7): compound wildcard index bounds silently collapsed to `[MinKey, MaxKey]`
`$scoreFusion` silently ignored `combination.expression` when `combination.method` was not `"expression"` (SERVER-125724, 8.3.7).
8.3's headline planner change remains the cost-based ranker as default.

WiredTiger eviction fixes in 8.3.8: WT-16954 fixed an eviction-thread panic caused by buffer overflow in the transaction state dump
